about.description: USDM1 is a digital, fully collateralized, USD-denominated sovereign bond issued natively onchain by the Republic of the Marshall Islands. Each unit represents 1 Marshall Islands bond backed by short-dated U.S. Treasuries, with 100% collateralization maintained through a U.S. trust structure. Interest is paid in additional USDM1, accrues continuously, and capitalizes monthly. Holders can redeem principal plus the past month’s pro-rated accrued interest at par. Secondary transfers are permissionless, while direct minting and redemption require registered-bondholder onboarding and KYC/KYB review by MIFS. Official docs also state that Surus publishes monthly reserve statements and that collateral is limited by policy to very short-duration U.S. Treasuries, with a current maximum maturity of 30 days.
about.registryInfo: USDM1 is issued by the Republic of the Marshall Islands, a sovereign UN member state. Reviewed public materials describe a capital-markets agent stack in which Surus Trust Company LLC acts as trustee, custodian, and collateral agent; MI Financial Services DAO LLC (MIFS) acts as transfer agent, token agent, and paying agent under supervision of the RMI Banking Commission as a VASP; Inca Digital supports compliance and monitoring; Cleary Gottlieb acts as legal counsel; and Guidepost Solutions supports compliance, risk, and governance oversight. Official materials also state the issuance is documented under an indenture and offering memorandum.
